correctness.rationale: Analytically reconstructed the crucial finite-measure lemma: if rho_phi(u_n)≤1 and b_n→∞, μ(|u_n|>b_n)≤μ(φ(x,b_n)<M)+1/M, so the measure vanishes by pointwise superlinearity and finite μ. Properness+global Δ2 puts φ(x,1) in L1 and dominated convergence gives small-constant modular/o(λ). Necessity uses φ right derivative and Fenchel equality to construct g=sup g_n with rho_phi*(g)≤2 from summable λ_n; published Theorem 3.2 then contradicts small-set uniform integrability on the high-amplitude sets. Sufficiency: modular limit implies norm bounded and Young inequality gives small-set integrability for every g∈Lphi*. Example φ(x,t)=x^1/4(t^{3/2+x}+t^{3+x}) has Δ2 K=16, nonconstrained fiber inf=0, associate constant conjugate bounded by integrable O(x^-1/2). All proof covers arbitrary S on finite separable measure with stated proper N and Delta2; no computation substituted.
